event.name: c. 3000 BC: First Dynasty sequence includes Narmer, Hor-Aha, Djer and Djet; dating uncertain

r2SourceEvidence.review_note: The conventional sequence includes Narmer, Hor-Aha, Djer and Djet. Absolute chronology varies: the First Dynasty article discusses different radiocarbon studies. The 3000 BCE slot is a contextual reference, not a claim these individuals were all alive, reigned together, or were present here in 3000 BCE. The identification of Menes with Narmer or Hor-Aha is debated; do not spawn Menes as an independent duplicate on this evidence. Abydos royal burial sites provide a regional reference, not the place of any individual event or an attested residence. No historical action or NPC behaviour is specified.
r2SourceEvidence.date_precision: Approximate contextual indexing anchor; not a date for an accession, death, lifespan or event.
r2SourceEvidence.location_precision: Abydos-area burial reference, not a proven location of participants during life. Radius is a game search setting.
